meaning:
ἰσκαριώθ, ὁ indecl.
(Mrk.3:19 14:10, Luk.6:16, elsewhere -ιώτης; V. infr.) and Ἰσκαριώτης, -ου (Heb. prob. קִרְיָא אִישׁ; see Swete, Mk., 319),
Iscariot: surname of Judas, ll. with supr., also Mat.10:4 26:14, Mrk.14:43 (WH, R, omit), Luk.22:3, Jhn.12:4 13:2 14:22; of his father Simon, Jhn.6:71 13:26.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.
Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
